verdict.rationale: Mem0's docs say you send raw conversation turns to `add` and it 'pulls the individual facts out of the conversation and stores each one separately,' so the extraction core is clearly delivered. A community comparison independently describes it as storing facts from conversations. Some automatic organization is also documented: Mem0 builds a graph from memories without a user-defined schema, and webhooks fire when memories are categorized. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of how Mem0 judges what is salient enough to keep, and of background consolidation (deduplicating or merging memories, resolving conflicts, running asynchronously), plus hands-on corroboration of extraction quality.
